rem Maximum number of divisors
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=485

use numbers
use sequences
use bits
use io
use cli

arg U integer = 100000000
arg K integer = 100000
arg Bs integer = 1000000

rem After small prime powers, at most
rem one prime factor remains.
Root = U isqrt
Primes = primes to Root copy
Bits = U binary len
Exponents = 1 to Bits copy
Grid = Primes Exponents outer **
Keep = Grid at most U
Powers = Grid reshape #
Mask = Keep reshape #
Slots = Mask indices
Powers = Powers Slots
Count = Exponents len
Prime = Primes (Slots // Count)
Exponent = Exponents (Slots mod Count)
StageCount = Powers len

fun Start block
  Stop = Start + Bs + K - 2 min U
  Size = Stop - Start + 1
  Tau = array shape Size fill 1
  Rest = Start to Stop copy
  rem Each stage changes e to e + 1.
  for I in 0 till StageCount
    Power = Powers I
    Factor = Prime I
    Order = Exponent I
    First = (Start + Power - 1) // Power
    First = First * Power - Start
    At = First till Size by Power
    Tau At //= Order
    Tau At *= Order + 1
    Rest At //= Factor
  end
  Extra = Rest greater 1
  Tau = Extra choose (Tau * 2) Tau
  rem van Herk maxima need two scans.
  Rows = (Size + K - 1) // K
  Length = Rows * K
  Padded = array shape Length fill 0
  Padded (0 till Size) = Tau
  Matrix = Padded reshape Rows K
  Forward = Matrix scan max axis 1
  Prefix = Forward reshape Length
  Reverse = Padded reverse
  Back = Reverse reshape Rows K
  Scanned = Back scan max axis 1
  Suffix = Scanned reshape Length
  Suffix = Suffix reverse
  Windows = Size - K + 1 max 0
  Left = Suffix (0 till Windows)
  Right = Prefix (K - 1 till Size)
  Maxima = Left max Right
  return Maxima sum
end

rem Overlap makes blocks independent.
rem Ranked sums release each block.
Starts = 1 to U - K + 1 by Bs
Answer = Starts block rank 0 sum
Answer print
